name: A Bit of Wet Work
summary: Sully McCleary saw naga charging ashore on Alcaz Island and fears the island is under attack. He asks you to strike at the naga and their leader.

sections.title: Naga on Alcaz
sections.body: Sully McCleary watched the shore of Alcaz Island while you listened in on Lady Proudmoore. He believes naga are attacking the island after seeing many of them rush ashore. Their spellcaster leader appears to be directing them, so Sully asks you to cut down the naga and bring her head to him.

faq.answer: Sully McCleary asks you to attack the naga he saw charging onto Alcaz Island.
Sully believes Alcaz Island may be under attack because he saw many naga rush ashore.
Sully saw a spellcaster barking orders at the naga. You learn her name is Tidemistress Ca'zass.

faq.q: Why am I going after the naga?
faq.answer: Sully says the naga are no friend to anyone and asks you to help by attacking them.
Sully sends you into Alcaz Prison to confront the naga.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Bit of Wet Work
